sloka: एष ज्ञाति सहस्रेण स्थपतिः परिवारितः ।कुशलो दण्डक अरण्ये वृद्धो भ्रातुः च ते सखा ॥२-८४-१२॥
transliteration: eṣa jñāti sahasreṇa sthapatiḥ parivāritaḥ ।kuśalo daṇḍaka araṇye vṛddho bhrātuḥ ca te sakhā ॥2-84-12॥

translations.english: Guha who has come here surrounded by too many thousands of his relations is fully acquainted with the Dandaka forest. He is an aged man and a friend of your brother said Sumatra.
